name: Society C | LA Purple Pop Rocks
description: Society C's LA Purple Pop Rocks is an Indica Hybrid, a cross of LA Pop Rocks and Purple Push Pop. It offers terpenes like Limonene and Linalool, with flavors of berries, diesel, and citrus, producing relaxing, tingly, and arousing effects.
